title: New Plymouth August
meta_desc: Discover the best of New Plymouth & Taranaki with kids in August. Enjoy mild weather, fewer crowds, and exciting events from $150-250/day for a family of 4.
intro: New Plymouth is a hidden family gem, boasting a volcanic mountain, stunning surf beaches, and NZ's best park. In August, the weather is mild, with average highs of 14°C and 9 hours of sunshine. It's an ideal time to explore the outdoors with kids, with popular attractions like Pukekura Park and the coastal walkway less crowded than in peak summer.

sections.heading: Weather and What's On
sections.body:
In August, New Plymouth experiences mild winter weather, with average highs of 14°C and lows of 7°C. It's a great time to enjoy the outdoors, with fewer crowds and lower prices. The Taranaki Arts Festival takes place in August, featuring a range of performances, exhibitions, and workshops. The festival includes free and ticketed events, with prices starting from $10.

The festival is suitable for all ages, with a range of family-friendly activities and events. Be sure to check the festival schedule and book tickets in advance for popular shows.
list: Taranaki Arts Festival ( ticket prices from $10)
New Plymouth Farmers' Market (every Sunday, free entry)

sections.heading: Best Activities for August
sections.body:
August is a great time to explore New Plymouth's outdoor attractions, with mild weather and fewer crowds. Pukekura Park is a must-visit, with its beautiful boating lake, playground, and zoo. The park is free to visit and suitable for all ages.

The coastal walkway is another highlight, stretching 13km along the city's dramatic black sand surf beaches. The walkway is free, cyclable, and suitable for families with kids of all ages.

sections.heading: Crowd Levels and Booking Ahead
sections.body:
August is a relatively quiet month in New Plymouth, with fewer tourists than in peak summer. However, it's still a good idea to book ahead for popular attractions and events, especially during the Taranaki Arts Festival.

Accommodation prices are generally lower in August, with options available from $150-250 per night for a family of 4. Book ahead to secure the best rates and availability.
list: Book accommodation at least 2 weeks in advance
Check festival schedules and book tickets early

sections.heading: Practical Tips for Families
sections.body: New Plymouth is a family-friendly city, with plenty of outdoor spaces and activities to enjoy. Here are some practical tips for families visiting in August:
list: Pack warm clothing, including jackets and gloves
Bring a waterproof jacket or umbrella, in case of rain
Take advantage of free outdoor activities, such as the coastal walkway and Pukekura Park
Check the festival schedule and plan your itinerary accordingly
Book a family-friendly accommodation with a kitchen, to save on food costs
